component.name: LocaLog
component.summary: Create meeting protocols with local AI

description.p: LocaLog turns meeting recordings into reviewable transcripts and protocol drafts using local AI. Organize recordings in projects, correct transcripts, edit drafts, and export Markdown or plain text.
No account or cloud AI service is required. AI models are downloaded separately with your consent. This is an early prototype; review generated documents before relying on them.

screenshot.caption: Start with a recording, using local processing
